Official Documentation

[!NOTE] All links that are labeled as “Official Documentation” come from api.realestateapi.com/reference.

[!NOTE] In addition to the URLs provided below, you can append .md to any of the URL’s to access the markdown source behind the documentation. For example, the Property Search API URL is https://developer.realestateapi.com/reference/property-search-api, and its corresponding markdown source is https://developer.realestateapi.com/reference/property-search-api.md.

[!NOTE] *Additionally, the source for the official documentation is on GitHub at RealEstateAPI/docs under the reference folder.
